name: Conformance: Agent Memory Injection Budget (RFC 0113)
description: RFC 0113. Drives a token-budgeted MemoryAdapter.list() over a seeded set whose total exceeds the budget AND that includes one single entry larger than the whole budget, plus a BYOK-redacted entry and a cross-tenant probe. The host surfaces, in workflow variables: the budgeted recency slice (`budgetedEntries`), its `budgetedTokenTotal`, the echoed `tokenBudget` + `tokenCounter`, an `overBudgetEntryId` (an entry larger than the budget) and `overBudgetEntryOmitted` flag, a `redactedContentSample` from the budgeted read (SR-1 re-assertion), a `crossTenantBudgetedProbe` (CTI-1 re-assertion under the budgeted path), and — only when the host also advertises memory.search semantic — `recencyOrder` + `relevanceOrder` id lists. See memory-injection-budget.test.ts.
